resources.string: Pair with DSH Mobile gateway
Paste the key or pairing link the DSH Mobile panel shows for the Android app. A dsh1. or dsh2. key is the whole credential; the address is only needed when the key is bare.
Pairing key or link
Gateway address
https://dsh2.example.com
Name for this device
Scan QR code
Point the camera at the pairing QR on the computer
Pair
Pairing…
Cancel
That is not a DSH Mobile pairing key or link.
A bare key names the computer but not its address. Add the address the DSH Mobile panel shows.
%1$s answered, but nothing there serves the DSH Mobile pairing routes. Is the dsh-mobile plugin enabled?
The certificate at %1$s is not the one this key names. Do not pair: this key belongs to a different computer, or something else is answering at that address.
That pairing key is no longer valid. Keys work once and expire after a few minutes, and generating a new one replaces the old — get a fresh key on the computer and try again.
%1$s refused this request. Only addresses the gateway knows itself by are accepted.
Too many attempts. Wait %1$d seconds and try again.
Could not reach %1$s. Check the address, and that the gateway is running and reachable from this phone.
Pairing failed.
